name: Ethiopia Yirgacheffe
description: Yirgacheffe is a well-known coffee-growing area in southern Ethiopia. Its coffees are usually valued for a light, aromatic profile with bright acidity. It shows well in filter methods, where delicate notes matter.

name: Colombia Huila
description: Colombia is one of the best-known arabica producers, and Huila is one of its major coffee regions. A balanced, sweet profile suits both filter coffee and milk-based drinks.

name: Brazil Santos
description: Brazil is the world's largest coffee producer. Brazilian beans often have a soft nutty-chocolate profile with moderate acidity, which is why they are popular for espresso and milk-based drinks.

name: Kenya AA
description: AA is a bean-size grade in the Kenyan classification. Kenyan lots are often described as juicy, with bright acidity and berry notes.

name: Vietnam Robusta
description: Vietnam is one of the largest robusta producers. Robusta is usually stronger and more bitter than arabica and contains more caffeine; it is often added to espresso blends.

name: Espresso blend
description: A blend is a mix of beans from different regions or varieties. The composition is chosen for balanced flavor and consistent results in espresso.
